sentences.en: On the fourth night, the back door opened.

sentences.ar: وطلع منه جو الهندي والعجوز، وبإيدهم إشي.
sentences.en: And out of it came Injun Joe and the old man, with something in their hands.
Not a box.
Smaller.

sentences.ar: ومشوا بالزقاق، وهَك وراهم، حافي، زي القطة.
sentences.en: And they walked down the alley, and Huck after them, barefoot, like a cat.

sentences.ar: مشوا للتلة، باتجاه بيت الأرملة دوغلاس.
sentences.en: They walked to the hill, toward the Widow Douglas's house.

sentences.ar: وهَك فكر: بيدفنوا الكنز عند الأرملة؟
sentences.en: And Huck thought: are they burying the treasure at the widow's?

sentences.ar: ووقفوا تحت شجرة، قريب من البيت، وهَك وقف ورا شجيرة، وسمع.
sentences.en: And they stopped under a tree, near the house, and Huck stood behind a bush, and listened.
The old man said: there is a light in the house.
She has people over.

sentences.ar: قال جو الهندي: بنستنى لحد ما يروحوا.
sentences.en: Injun Joe said: we wait until they leave.

sentences.ar: قال العجوز: يا جو، خلينا نترك هالشغلة.
sentences.en: The old man said: Joe, let us leave this job.
The widow did nothing.
Injun Joe said: her husband.

sentences.ar: زوجها كان القاضي، وحكم عليّ بالجلد، قدام القرية.
sentences.en: Her husband was the judge, and sentenced me to the whip, before the village.
He is dead.
And she will pay instead of him.
And I do not want to kill her.
I want to cut her face.
Huck did not wait to hear the rest.

sentences.ar: رجع لورا، على مهل، وبعدين ركض.
sentences.en: He backed away, slowly, and then ran.

sentences.ar: ركض عالتلة لبيت الويلزي، الرجل الكبير اللي عنده ولدين.
sentences.en: He ran up the hill to the Welshman's house, the old man with two sons.
And he pounded the door with his hands, and shouted: open!
Open quickly!
The Welshman opened, and said: who are you?
Huck said: Huck Finn.
Do not tell anyone I came.
But listen.
And he told everything.

sentences.ar: الويلزي وولاده أخدوا بنادقهم، وطلعوا بالعتمة.
sentences.en: The Welshman and his sons took their guns, and went out into the dark.

sentences.ar: وهَك ركض وراهم لحد الشجيرة، ووقف، وسمع.
sentences.en: And Huck ran after them as far as the bush, and stopped, and listened.
Silence.

sentences.ar: وبعدين صوت بنادق، وصراخ، وأقدام بتركض.
sentences.en: And then the sound of guns, and shouts, and running feet.
And Huck did not wait.

sentences.ar: ركض عالتلة لتحت، وما وقف لحد القرية.
sentences.en: He ran down the hill, and did not stop until the village.
And in the morning, the whole village knew.

sentences.ar: حدا هجم على الأرملة، والويلزي طردهم.
sentences.en: Someone had attacked the widow, and the Welshman had driven them off.

sentences.ar: بس ما حدا عرف مين اللي حذر الويلزي.
sentences.en: But no one knew who had warned the Welshman.
Except the Welshman, and he had sworn to keep quiet.
